answer: In crisis negotiation an agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake escrowed under a rotating juniper-keyed quorum, so a single ripple of collusion is detectable before it spreads. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
